results.content: AI assistants and agents navigate websites to gather, compare, and suggest information for potential buyers. Bifura examines how AI crawlers interact with a webpage that lacks JavaScript, showcasing the retrieved content, structured data, and the interpretations made by AI models alongside the user-facing interface. It generates an Agent readiness score ranging from 0 to 100, categorizes findings as either code-derived or model-evaluated, and formulates a strategic plan featuring milestones at 30, 60, and 90 days. Users can pose questions that a buyer might ask an AI assistant and can follow the origins of each response. The Pro and Agency subscription options enable users to experiment with modifications on a sandbox version of the page and reassess the scoring. These plans also offer [...] the page and reassess the scoring. These plans also offer features such as monitoring and alerts, the ability to track AI visibility, context budgeting, AI crawler logs, and comparisons against competitors; additionally, the Agency plan includes the option for white-label reporting and access to a REST API. Furthermore, this comprehensive tool empowers users to enhance their website's performance effectively while keeping up with industry standards.
